templates.why_chosen: Circled steps 1-8 walk a generic Traffic Manager pipeline (a), its cell-memory layout (b), then Themis's own hierarchical-bitmap scheduler with dual SRAM and HBM controllers (c), a zoom from generic module to the paper's extension.
